PLAN "12-Week Fat Loss and Glycaemic Control"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary fat_loss:
    name "Reduce body fat while preserving lean mass"
  GOAL secondary glycaemic_control:
    name "Improve HbA1c from 7.2 toward 6.5 or below through resistance training, daily walking, and steady carbohydrate intake"
  GOAL nutrition protein:
    name "Protein 1.2 to 1.6 g per kg bodyweight per day, spread across 3 to 4 meals"
  GOAL nutrition carbohydrate:
    name "Consistent carbohydrate of roughly 45 to 60 g per main meal, prioritising high-fibre sources (25 to 30 g fibre per day)"
  GOAL nutrition meal_timing:
    name "Do not skip meals while on metformin; eat a source of carbohydrate with each meal and never train fasted"
  GOAL safety glucose:
    name "Check blood glucose before and after sessions; keep fast-acting carbohydrate available; stop and recover if symptomatic of hypoglycaemia; consult prescriber before changing medication or intensity"
  GOAL safety progression:
    name "Keep RPE 6 to 8 in weeks 1 to 4, progress load gradually, avoid high-impact jumping and breath-holding maximal efforts"

PHASES
  PHASE "Foundation" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Full Body A":
        warmup:
          walking 8m
          arm_circles 30 seconds
          hip_circles 30 seconds
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 2x10..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_press 2x10..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          seated_row 2x10..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 2x10..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          plank 2x20 seconds rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
          hamstring_stretch 30 seconds
          chest_stretch 30 seconds
      DAY Wednesday training 40m "Cardio and Core":
        warmup:
          cycling 8m
        main straight_sets:
          leg_press 2x12..15 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          lat_pulldown 2x10..12 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          glute_bridge 2x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          dead_bug 2x8..10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          cycling 5m
          quad_stretch 30 seconds
      DAY Friday training 45m "Full Body B":
        warmup:
          walking 8m
          cat_cow 60 seconds
        main straight_sets:
          step_up 2x8..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          push_up 2x8..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          cable_row 2x10..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          bicep_curl 2x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 2x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
